# cosmoner_redis_database (Resource)

A managed Redis-compatible (Valkey) database. **Billed from creation**, to the project's saved card.

`apply` waits until the database is active, up to `timeouts.create` (default 15 minutes). A database that ends in an error, or is still starting at the deadline, is kept in state as tainted, so the next apply replaces it; the provider never deletes it on its own. A create the API refuses leaves nothing behind.

The API has no route to change a database, so changing any argument replaces it, **and its data with it**.

Needs `redis:read` and `redis:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cosmoner_redis_database" "cache" {
  name        = "cache"
  plan        = "valkey-1gb"
  region      = "se-sto"
  persistence = "AOF_EVERY_1_SECOND"
}

resource "cosmoner_secret" "redis_password" {
  name  = "REDIS_PASSWORD"
  value = cosmoner_redis_database.cache.password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name: lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens, up to 40 characters.
- `plan` (String) Plan slug from the Redis catalogue, e.g. `valkey-1gb`. The plan decides the memory and what runs the database.
- `region` (String) Region slug from the Redis catalogue. The API refuses a region the plan is not sold in.

### Optional

- `persistence` (String) How data survives a restart: `NONE` (the default), `AOF_EVERY_WRITE`, `AOF_EVERY_1_SECOND`, or `SNAPSHOT_EVERY_1_HOUR`, `_6_HOURS`, `_12_HOURS`. The API refuses a mode the plan does not offer.
- `project_id` (String) Project the resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the database was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `engine` (String) `VALKEY` or `REDIS`.
- `engine_version` (String) Engine version the database runs.
- `host` (String) Host to connect to.
- `id` (String) Database ID.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory the plan provides, in MB.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password to authenticate with. Readable with `redis:read`.
- `port` (Number) Port to connect on.
- `status` (String) `ACTIVE` once ready; otherwise `CREATING` or `ERROR`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for the database to become active. Defaults to `15m`.
- `delete` (String) How long to wait for the database to be deleted. Defaults to `15m`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<redis_id>, or just <redis_id> when the provider sets a project.
terraform import cosmoner_redis_database.cache proj_123/clx0redis
```
